name: Target Size (Minimum)
explanation: Clickable or tappable targets, like buttons, links styled as buttons, and form controls, need a hit area of at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels. This is the more attainable Level AA counterpart to the stricter 44 by 44 pixel AAA requirement in SC 2.5.5. Exceptions apply to links inline within a sentence of running text, to controls whose size is set by the user agent rather than page styling, like a default browser checkbox, and to cases where a comparably usable larger target or alternative method for the same function exists elsewhere on the page.
whoItAffects: People with motor disabilities, hand tremors, or reduced fine motor precision are much more likely to miss a small target or accidentally activate an adjacent one, so a larger minimum hit area meaningfully reduces the chance of a mis-tap or mis-click. This matters especially on touchscreens, where a fingertip covers a larger, less precise area than a mouse cursor, making undersized icon buttons and close-together controls a common source of accidental taps.
howToTest: Use the browser's element inspector to measure the full clickable or tappable area of each interactive control, not just the visible icon or text inside it, since padding can extend the actual hit area beyond what's visually drawn. Confirm each target is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels. This doesn't apply to links within a running sentence of text, to controls whose size the browser itself controls rather than the page's CSS, or where an equally usable larger version of the same control exists elsewhere.

check.question: A form has a small "x" icon button to clear a search field, with a clickable area measuring 18 by 18 CSS pixels, and no larger version of this control exists anywhere else on the page. Does this pass SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)?
choices: Yes, because 18x18 pixels is close enough to be functionally usable
No, because this falls short of the 24x24 CSS pixel minimum required at Level AA
Yes, because clear/reset buttons are exempt from target size requirements
It depends only on whether the icon has sufficient color contrast
